title: Neo4j Alternatives Due Diligence — PuppyGraph vs. TuringDB vs. Apache AGE
summary: Due-diligence comparison of PuppyGraph, TuringDB, and Apache AGE as Neo4j alternatives for Aura, recommending Neo4j retention and an optional Apache AGE proof of concept.
notes: Research path and comparison/recommendation structure indicate supporting architecture analysis, but no ADR status or formal accepted decision is present.
